description: The only MCP database server for PostgreSQL, MySQL, and SQL Server in one session. 26 tools across 4 tiers: schema introspection, cross-database compare, query firewall, anomaly detection, PII scanning, N+1 detection, EXPLAIN/optimization, query history, and runtime connection management. Read-only enforced at three independent layers (SQL guard, session READ ONLY, optional per-connection custom firewall). OAuth 2.1 (keyless) or API key auth. Database connections are added per-tenant via the `add_connection` tool *after* sign-in — not at install time. Globally edge-deployed for low latency.
